title_en: Modern 2+1 Apartment with Panoramic Veranda - Heart of the Block
description_en: 📍 Location: Block, near Credins Bank - in a modern building with new facade and Abisnet cable system. 🏢 Floor: 6 out of 10 📐 Total area: 150 m² gross | Net area: 135 m² 🛗 Building with elevator 📄 Status: With mortgage 💶 Price: €550,000 (disputable) ✅ Possibility of parking with extra payment 🏦 Credit buyers accepted 🏠 Apartment layout: 2+1 typology - with contemporary and quality furniture Spacious living room, naturally lit Modern integrated kitchen 2 comfortable bedrooms 1 veranda panoramic with an impressive view over the former villa of Enver Hoxha Additional balcony with access from the day premises ✨ Property advantages: Located in one of the most elite and sought-after areas of Tirana Orientation and natural light throughout the day Unique and unusual view in the city center Ideal for long-term residence or investment 📞 Contact us for more information or to organize a visit to the property.
